purpose: Find substantive novel useful output before flagship construction
human_expert_search: unavailable; not replaced by a model labeled human

evaluation.novelty: specific capability gap vs strongest identified primary prior art; fails if ordinary extension or adequate prior construction
evaluation.usefulness: named beneficiary and useful output beyond benchmark convenience
evaluation.technical: executable decisive construction with invariant obligations, independent comparator and falsifier
evaluation.commercial: same offering, explicit value/participation/cost/resource model; observed and assumed separated

selection_rule: All four dimensions must be defensible before flagship adoption; failure preserved; selection is unblinded exploratory judgment
limitations: query budgets are caps, not evidence of equal hidden compute
no prospective real-buyer claim from synthetic evidence
